subject: general
question: As per the Census of India - 2011, the density of population per km² was ______ persons.
solution:
The correct answer is __**382 persons**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the Census of India - 2011, the density of population was **382 persons** per km².
 
• The census data provides critical information on the population density, helping in the formulation of policies and allocation of resources.
 
• Population density is calculated as the number of people per unit area of land.
 
• It is an important demographic indicator that helps in understanding the population distribution of a country.
 
• The states with the highest population density are Bihar, West Bengal, and Kerala, while the states with the lowest population density are Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, and Sikkim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Census of India** is conducted every ten years and is one of the largest administrative exercises in the world.
 
• The first census in India was conducted in **1872**, and the first complete census was conducted in **1881**.
 
• The census provides comprehensive data on various demographic, social, and economic aspects of the population.
 
• This data is crucial for planning and policy-making at national, state, and local levels.
 
• The Census of India also collects information on housing, amenities, and assets possessed by households.
